articles.title: The Comeback King - Official Trailer - IGN
articles.summary:
Fall hard. Come back stronger. Watch the trailer for The Comeback King, an upcoming comedy movie starring Glen Powell, Cristin Milioti, Madelyn Cline, Stavros Halkias, Li Jin Hao, Leanne Morgan, Kumail Nanjiani, Vanessa Bayer, Atsuko Okatsuka, Tig Notaro, Chris Fleming, Mike Birbiglia (Trainwreck), and Big Fella (Cookin’ Wit’ Big Fella), with appearances by country music superstars including Jelly Roll, Brad Paisley, Miranda Lambert, Shaboozey, Chris Stapleton, Brandi Carlile, Luke Bryan, and Reba McEntire.The Comeback King stars Powell as Aubrey King, a hot-shot country sensation whose songs about drinkin’ and lovin’ are fueling his rise but are leaving him feeling like a commodity, exacerbated by the fact that he’s dating the world’s biggest pop superstar, Missy (Madelyn Cline). After Aubrey discovers that he is not Missy’s one-and-only and breaks up with her, an irate Missy goes on offense and releases a track that makes Aubrey the cheater, sending his life and career into a rapid downward spiral.Faced with a mandatory timeout, Aubrey dodges the spotlight and returns to college to finally finish his degree and discover what he wants to say in his music, sparked by Sam, a no-nonsense professor (Cristin Milioti) who is initially unimpressed by the celebrity crashing in her classroom.

The Comeback King is produced by Kevin Misher, Judd Apatow, Glen Powell, and Dan Cohen. Barry Mendel and Josh Church serve as executive producers. The screenplay is by Judd Apatow and Glen Powell. The Comeback King, directed by Judd Apatow, opens in theaters on February 5, 2027.
